scope: Independent source, cell-expression and invented-input control review only. No historical likelihood, fit, simulation, actual table reconciliation or new scientific output aggregation was executed in this review.

checks.independent_mapping_basis: Explicit manuscript row headings/contrast direction/fold and phase; semantic formulas constructed independently, then compared to every new expression and author crosswalk. Displayed numeric scores were not expression operands.
checks.new_expression_leaves: Only actual components joint/timing/M/n_events; fixed sum/scale and target-count divisors. No expected-score or ledger-score operands.
checks.profile_rule: All seven predeclared nodes per case/model; actual training NLL minus actual selected training NLL <= 2.0; selected coordinate and sparse included nodes formatted; exact threshold included. Test NLL is diagnostic only and test vectors must equal training vectors.
checks.profile_failure_controls: Missing rows propagate uncovered, malformed/nonfinite/state-mismatched rows fail; actual joint/NLL signs checked; empty support derived from all nodes, never copied from display.
checks.evidence_checks: Additional registry SHA, row file/ZIP/member SHA, passed/replayed/id and state/cache/Python/native-source identity required. Additional rows cannot replace base rows. Missing mapped actuals remain uncovered and are not replaced by expected values.

retained_regression_record_inspected.basis_for_preservation: Exact old cell records and old arithmetic AST are unchanged; actual arithmetic rerun belongs to conductor admission.

limitations: This approval is for the source and expression map, not acceptance of yet-unperformed additional table arithmetic.
The module documents passed as all mapped supplied cells reconcile; it does not mean all chapter tables are covered. Missing actual evidence is visible as uncovered.
Sparse profile support is a descriptive training-score set, not a confidence interval; membership stability relative to replay tolerances is explicitly diagnostic.
